reports.title: Incyte Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Incyte is raising its full year 2026 net sales guidance for Opzelura to $1,100 - $1,120 million, Hematology and Oncology to $890 - $910 million and total net sales to $5,210 - $5,300 million to reflect continued strong performance across the portfolio. Incyte is reaffirming its full year 2026 guidance for all other categories.
Incyte’s guidance for the fiscal year 2026 is summarized below.

Current | Previous
Total net sales | $5,210 - $5,300 million | $5,130 - $5,260 million
Jakafi net sales(1) | Unchanged | $3,220 - $3,270 million
Opzelura net sales(2) | $1,100 - $1,120 million | $1,050 - $1,100 million
Hematology and Oncology net sales(3) | $890 - $910 million | $860 - $890 million
Total GAAP R&D and SG&A operating expenses(4) | Unchanged | $4,915 - $4,995 million
Total Non-GAAP R&D and SG&A operating expenses(4,5) | Unchanged | $4,625 - $4,695 million
